title: 第九十四章生死相随第九十三章剑心通明
content_zh:
第九十四章生死相随
河西长风卷着细碎黄沙，拍打在凉州八丈青石城墙上，斑驳城堞插满锈迹兵刃，祁连山积雪在远天泛着冷白，整座边城浸在一片萧瑟寒凉里。萧琰一身玄色劲装，腰间悬着柄龙泉古剑，墨发以素银发束高挽，侧脸线条冷硬凌厉，指节无意识摩挲着袖中一枚半碎的玉扣，那是苏玲去年在丹州集市亲手给他雕的。
身侧女子一袭月白长衫，外罩浅灰防风斗篷，乌发仅用一支木簪绾起，眉眼温婉柔和，唯有一双眸子藏着不输江湖儿女的韧劲。苏玲抬手，轻轻拂去萧琰肩头落沙，指尖触到他肩头旧伤时，动作骤然放轻，声音被风沙磨得细软：“昨夜城防署的探子来过，曙盟主力已进驻城西月华府，咱们寻剑谱的事，怕是走漏风声了。”
萧琰垂眸看向她，眼底冰封的戾气尽数化开，伸手将她被风吹乱的鬓发拢至耳后，掌心带着常年握剑的薄茧，蹭过她耳廓时温软：“无妨，有我在，不会让你涉险。当年萧氏满门蒙冤，唯有《天狼诀》下半卷藏于凉州古塔，寻到谱册，方能揭穿魏无垢阉党与曙盟勾结构陷忠良的阴谋，此事凶险，你若想出城避一避，我即刻送你去山下农户村落。”
苏玲轻轻摇头，反手扣住他手腕，指尖牢牢嵌进他皮肉，力道坚定，不见半分退缩：“自三年前乱葬岗你将濒死的我从尸堆里抱出来，我便说过，萧琰，你去哪，我便去哪。生，同屋而居；死，同穴而埋，生死相随，绝非戏言。区区凉州宵小，还拆不散我们。”
三年前的画面骤然撞进萧琰脑海。彼时他身负灭门血海深仇，孤身潜伏边关，途经城郊乱葬岗，撞见浑身是伤、被仇家弃于荒野的苏玲。她爹娘皆是镇守边关的武官，因不肯同流合污投靠阉党，一夜之间满门屠戮，只剩她一人侥幸逃生。萧琰本是冷心冷情之人，见她奄奄一息仍攥着半块刻着玲字的玉佩，一时心软，带在身边疗伤。
朝夕相伴三载，刀光剑影里相互扶持，大漠风沙中彼此取暖，爱意早已刻入骨血。萧琰原想待复仇大事了结，便寻一处江南水乡，同她远离江湖纷争，安稳度日，却不曾想线索直指凉州，曙盟魏无垢的爪牙早已在此布下天罗地网。
二人落脚在城南一间老旧客栈，店名风沙渡，店主是位隐退的老镖师，受过萧琰恩惠，行事谨慎，从不向外透露住客行踪。客栈后院有一方小院，墙角栽着两株耐旱胡杨，窗下摆着粗木长桌，苏玲每日都会在此煎药，萧琰肩头、心口数道旧伤，每逢风沙天便隐隐作痛。
此刻暮色沉落，凉州城内万家灯火次第亮起，巡城兵卒甲胄碰撞之声沿街回荡，混杂着商贩吆喝、驼队铜铃，边城喧嚣之下暗藏汹涌杀机。苏玲端来一碗温热汤药，递到萧琰手中，烛火摇曳，映得她眉眼温柔，低声叮嘱：“药里加了当归与防风，能压一压旧伤寒气，今日探查古塔路线，你同三名曙盟打手交手，内力耗损过重，夜里切勿运功调息。”
萧琰仰头将汤药一饮而尽，苦涩药味漫过喉咙，心底却暖意翻涌，他拉过苏玲，让她坐在自己身侧，手臂稳稳环住她腰肢，目光望向窗外漆黑城楼：“明日子时，西城外镇龙古塔守卫最弱，传闻下半卷《天狼诀》封存在塔底密室，曙盟大批高手近日云集凉州，皆是为剑谱而来。魏无垢意图借天狼神功操控藩镇兵马，若是让他得手，河西百姓必遭战乱屠戮。”
苏玲靠在他肩头，鼻尖萦绕着他身上独有的剑鞘冷铁与浅淡药草气息，轻声梳理全盘局势：“我今日上街打探，月华府内藏有百余死士，领头之人是血刀门门主吕岩秋，此人出手狠辣，掌带剧毒，寻常刀剑难伤其肉身。城守罗海早已被曙盟收买，全城四门皆有重兵盘查，一旦我们夺取剑谱，很难顺利出城。”
萧琰指尖轻叩桌面，眼底寒光乍现：“兵来将挡，水来土掩。我龙泉剑修习多年，足以抗衡吕岩秋，只是怕缠斗之时，无暇护你周全。”
“我并非只会依附你的弱女子。”苏玲抬眼，从腰间抽出一柄三寸短匕，匕身莹白，是她亲手锻造的寒玉短刃，“这柄碎星匕伴我三年，暗器、近身搏杀我皆熟练，真到绝境，我能自保，亦能替你分担敌手，绝不会拖你后腿。”
萧琰看着她眼中决然，心口一紧，收紧怀抱，额头抵住她的额角，声音低沉郑重：“我从不惧千军万马，唯一放不下的只有你。若明日行动出现意外，你不必管我，寻机会冲出凉州城，往南走，去找我昔年交好的边关守将，安稳过完余生。”
话音未落，苏玲抬手捂住他嘴唇，眼眶微微泛红，语气带着一丝嗔怪，更多却是至死不渝的笃定：“萧琰，你莫要再说这般生分话。三年前我身中剧毒躺在乱葬岗，本就已是死人，是你给我一条活路。你若出事，我独活世间又有何意？我们说好生死相随，不管前路刀山火海，都要并肩同行，绝不独自偷生。”
夜风穿窗而入，吹灭桌旁半截蜡烛，小院陷入昏暗，唯有远处城楼火光遥遥映照二人相拥的身影。萧琰不再劝说，只是将她抱得更紧，唇轻轻落在她发顶，无声许下相守一生的诺言。
夜半时分，城内忽然响起急促铜锣声，巡城兵卒大肆搜捕外来江湖客，马蹄声踏碎寂静，沿街砸开无数客栈房门。老店主匆忙叩响院门，神色慌张：“萧公子、苏姑娘，不好了，曙盟放出画像，全城搜捕你们二人，官兵马上就要查到风沙渡了！”
苏玲立刻起身，迅速将贴身存放的伤药、解毒散裹入布包，萧琰握紧龙泉古剑，周身气息骤然凛冽，护住苏玲退至墙角隐蔽处：“店家，连累你了，待我们引开官兵，你自行关门躲避，莫要被牵连。”
老镖师摆了摆手，眼底坦荡：“当年公子救我独孙性命，些许小事何谈连累，后院地窖可暂避一时，只是地窖狭窄，躲不过长久搜查。”
话音刚落，沉重木门被兵卒粗暴撞开，甲胄摩擦声响此起彼伏，十余名持戈官兵涌入院内，领头之人一身灰衣，正是曙盟副统领，手持一幅萧琰与苏玲的画像，冷喝出声：“奉都督罗海之命，捉拿钦犯萧琰、苏玲，藏匿不报者，同罪处死！”

萧琰将苏玲护在身后，龙泉剑出鞘半寸，凛冽剑光划破黑暗，风沙卷入院中，吹得衣袍猎猎作响。“想要拿我们，先踏过我的尸身。”
灰衣统领冷笑一声，挥手示意官兵合围：“萧氏余孽还敢负隅顽抗？今日凉州城便是你们二人埋骨之地！”
数十支长枪直刺而来，萧琰身形倏然掠出，龙泉剑挽出层层剑花，金铁交鸣之声刺耳，转瞬便放倒三名靠前兵卒。灰衣统领自袖中甩出九节钢鞭，鞭身淬满见血封喉的蚀骨毒，裹挟劲风直劈萧琰后心。
苏玲见状，足尖轻点院墙腾空而起，寒玉碎星匕脱手飞出，精准擦过钢鞭鞭身，力道震得统领手臂发麻，攻势一滞。她落地迅速折返至萧琰身侧，一左一右与他并肩而立，短匕横在身前，目光不惧迎面数十名官兵。
二人配合默契，三年同闯江湖练出的无间招式此刻尽数施展。萧琰长剑大开大合，正面抵挡大批兵卒攻势；苏玲身形灵巧飘忽，游走侧翼，以短匕牵制敌手，专挑对手关节、经脉薄弱处下手，短短半柱香功夫，院内倒地官兵过半，余下之人不敢贸然上前，围在院门口不敢突进。
灰衣统领面色阴沉，自知单凭官兵难以拿下二人，吹响腰间信号哨，尖锐哨声穿透街巷，片刻之后，数十名身着黑衣、面罩遮脸的曙盟死士飞速赶来，个个手持利刃，招式狠辣无匹。
第九十四章生死相随
“此地不宜久留，我们突围出城，先往镇龙古塔方向走！”萧琰低声对苏玲道，手腕运力，龙泉剑掀起一道强劲剑气，逼退身前死士，一手牵住苏玲手腕，二人顺着院墙缺口纵身跃出，冲入昏暗街巷。
身后追兵紧追不舍，哨声、喝骂声、脚步声密密麻麻紧随其后，整条凉州南街瞬间陷入混乱。沿街百姓慌忙紧闭门窗，只敢透过缝隙观望这场江湖厮杀。萧琰一路护着苏玲，避开街巷埋伏，专挑狭窄巷道穿行，奈何曙盟死士熟稔城内地形，分多路包抄，渐渐将二人逼至城西一处废弃磨坊。

Chapter 94: Life and Death
The long wind from the west of the river blew up the fine yellow sand and slapped it on the eight-foot-long bluestone city wall of Liangzhou. The mottled battlements were covered with rusty weapons. The snow in the Qilian Mountains glowed cold white in the distant sky. The entire border city was immersed in a desolate cold. Xiao Yan was dressed in black attire, with an ancient Longquan sword hanging from his waist. His black hair was tied high with plain silver hair, and his profile was cold and sharp. His knuckles unconsciously rubbed a half-broken jade button in his sleeve, which Su Ling carved for him personally at the Danzhou market last year.
The woman next to her is wearing a moon-white gown and a light gray windproof cloak. Her black hair is tied up with only a wooden hairpin. Her eyebrows are gentle and gentle. Only one pair of eyes hides a tenacity that is not inferior to those in the world. Su Ling raised her hand and gently brushed away the fallen sand on Xiao Yan's shoulder. When her fingertips touched the old injury on his shoulder, her movements suddenly softened, and her voice was softened by the wind and sand: "Spies from the City Defense Department came last night. The main force of the Dawn League has stationed in Yuehua Mansion in the west of the city. I'm afraid the news about our search for the sword manual has leaked."
Xiao Yan lowered his eyes and looked at her, all the frozen anger in his eyes melted away. He stretched out his hand to tuck her wind-blown temple hair behind her ears. His palms were covered with thin calluses from holding swords for many years. When he brushed against her ears, he said softly: "It doesn't matter. I'm here and I won't let you take risks. Back then, Mrs. Xiao Many people have been wronged, but only the second half of "The Secret of the Heavenly Wolf" is hidden in the ancient pagoda of Liangzhou. Only by finding the genealogy can we expose the conspiracy of Wei Wugou's eunuchs and the Shu League to frame Zhongliang. This matter is dangerous. If you want to go out of town to escape, I will send you to the village at the foot of the mountain immediately. "
Su Ling shook her head gently and clasped his wrist with her backhand. Her fingertips were firmly embedded in his flesh. Her strength was firm and she didn't flinch at all: "Since you took me out of the dying body in the mass grave three years ago, I have said, Xiao Yan, I will go wherever you go. When we live, we live in the same house; when we die, we are buried in the same cave. Life and death go hand in hand. It's no joke. We are just young in Liangzhou, but we can't be separated."
The scene from three years ago suddenly popped into Xiao Yan's mind. At that time, he was burdened with a blood feud that resulted in the death of his family. He was lurking alone at the border. Passing by a mass grave on the outskirts of the city, he bumped into Su Ling, who was covered in wounds and abandoned in the wilderness by her enemies. Her parents were both military attachés guarding the border. Because they refused to join in the rebellion and join the eunuchs, the whole family was massacred overnight, and she was the only one who managed to escape. Xiao Yan was originally a cold-hearted person, but when he saw that she was dying and still clutching half of a jade pendant with the Chinese character "Ling" engraved on it, he felt soft and took it with him to heal her injuries.
They have been together day and night for three years, supporting each other in the light of swords and shadows, keeping each other warm in the wind and sand of the desert, and their love has long been engraved in their bones and blood. Xiao Yan originally wanted to wait for the revenge matter to be over, so he would find a water town in the south of the Yangtze River to stay away from the disputes in the world and live a stable life with her. However, he never thought that the clues would lead directly to Liangzhou, where the minions of Wei Wugou of the Shu Alliance had already laid a dragnet.
The two settled in an old inn in the south of the city, named Fengshadu. The owner was a retired old bodyguard who had received favor from Xiao Yan. He acted cautiously and never revealed the whereabouts of his guests. There is a small courtyard in the backyard of the inn, with two drought-tolerant Populus euphratica plants planted in the corner, and a long wooden table placed under the window. Su Ling would cook medicine here every day. Xiao Yan had several old wounds on his shoulders and heart, which ached a little every time it was windy and sandy.
At this moment, dusk is falling, and the lights of tens of thousands of houses in Liangzhou City are lighting up one after another. The sound of soldiers patrolling the city clashing with their armor echoes along the street, mixed with the shouts of merchants and the bells of camel teams. Underneath the hustle and bustle of the border town, there is a raging murderous intention. Su Ling brought a bowl of warm decoction and handed it to Xiao Yan's hand. The flickering candlelight made her eyes look gentle, and she whispered: "The medicine is added with angelica and parsnips, which can suppress the old typhoid. Today, we are exploring the route of the ancient pagoda. You have fought with three Dawn League thugs, and your internal energy has been excessively depleted. Do not exercise and adjust your breath at night."
Xiao Yan raised his head and drank the decoction in one gulp. The bitter taste of the medicine filled his throat, but warmth surged in his heart. He pulled Su Ling and let her sit beside him. His arms were firmly around her waist, and he looked out the window at the dark tower: "Tomorrow, the guards of the Dragon Ancient Tower outside the West City are the weakest. It is rumored that the second half of the "Sirius Art" is sealed in a secret room at the bottom of the tower. A large number of masters from the Dawn League have gathered in Liangzhou recently, all for this purpose.The sword manual comes. Wei Wugou intends to use the Heavenly Wolf's magical power to control the soldiers and horses of the feudal town. If he succeeds, the people in Hexi will be slaughtered in war. "
Su Ling leaned on his shoulder, her nose lingering with the unique scent of cold iron from the scabbard and the faint scent of herbs, and she softly sorted out the overall situation: "I went to the street today to investigate and found out that there are more than a hundred dead soldiers hidden in the Yuehua Mansion. The leader is Lu Yanqiu, the master of the Blood Knife Sect. This man's attacks are ruthless, and his palms are highly poisonous. It is difficult for ordinary swords to hurt his body. The city guard Luo Hai has been bribed by the Dawn Alliance, and there are heavy troops checking the four gates of the city. Once we seize the sword manual, it will be difficult to get out of the city smoothly. "
Xiao Yan tapped the table with his fingertips, and a cold light suddenly appeared in his eyes: "The soldiers will block it, and the water will cover it with the soil. I have practiced Longquan Sword for many years, and I am strong enough to compete with Lu Yanqiu, but I am afraid that I will not have time to protect you during the fight. "
"I am not a weak woman who will only rely on you. "Su Ling raised her eyes and pulled out a three-inch dagger from her waist. The body of the dagger was white. It was a cold jade short blade forged by her own hands. "This Star-Shattering Dagger has been with me for three years. I am proficient in hidden weapons and close combat. Even in desperate situations, I can protect myself and share the enemy's strength for you. I will never hold you back. "
Xiao Yan looked at her with determination in her eyes, his heart tightened, he tightened his arms, pressed his forehead against hers, and said in a low and solemn voice: "I have never been afraid of thousands of troops, and the only one I can't let go of is you. If something unexpected happens during tomorrow's operation, you don't have to worry about me. Look for an opportunity to rush out of Liangzhou City, go south, find the border guard I made friends with in the past, and live the rest of your life in peace. "
Before she finished speaking, Su Ling raised her hand to cover his lips, her eyes were slightly red, her tone was a little bit resentful, but more of an unswerving determination: "Xiao Yan, don't say such harsh words again. Three years ago, I was lying in a mass grave with severe poison in my body. I was already dead. It was you who gave me a way to live. If something happens to you, what's the point of me living alone in this world? We promised that we would be together in life and death. No matter whether the road ahead was dangerous, we would walk side by side, and we would never live alone. "
The night wind blew in through the window, blowing out half of the candles beside the table, and the small courtyard fell into darkness. Only the firelight of the tower in the distance reflected the two figures embracing each other. Xiao Yan stopped persuading her and just hugged her tighter. His lips gently landed on the top of her hair, silently making a promise to stay together for the rest of their lives.
In the middle of the night, the sound of gongs suddenly sounded in the city, and soldiers patrolling the city searched for outsiders. The sound of horse hooves broke the silence, and countless inn doors were smashed open along the streets. The old shopkeeper hurriedly knocked on the courtyard door, looking panicked: "Mr. Xiao, Miss Su, what's wrong, Shumeng has released the portraits, and the whole city is searching for you two. The officers and soldiers will soon find Fengshadu! "
Su Ling immediately stood up and quickly wrapped the wound medicine and detoxification powder stored close to her body into a cloth bag. Xiao Yan held the Longquan ancient sword tightly, and the aura around her body suddenly became cold. She protected Su Ling and retreated to a hidden place in the corner: "Shopkeeper, we have implicated you. When we lure the officers and soldiers away, you can close the door and hide yourself. Don't be implicated. "
The old escort waved his hand and said with magnanimity in his eyes: "Young Master saved my only grandson's life back then. It's not a small thing to worry about. The cellar in the backyard can be a temporary refuge, but the cellar is narrow and cannot be evaded for a long time." "
As soon as he finished speaking, the heavy wooden door was violently knocked open by the soldiers. The sound of armor scraping could be heard one after another. More than a dozen armed officers and soldiers poured into the courtyard. The leader, dressed in gray, was the deputy commander of the Shu League. Holding a portrait of Xiao Yan and Su Ling, he shouted coldly: "On the order of the Commander-in-Chief Luo Hai, we are arresting the imperial convicts Xiao Yan and Su Ling. Anyone who hides and fails to report will be executed for the same crime! "
Xiao Yan protected Su Ling behind him, and the Longquan sword was half an inch out of its sheath. The cold sword light cut through the darkness, and the wind and sand swept into the courtyard, making the clothes rustle. “If you want to take us, step on my body first. "
The gray-clothed commander sneered and waved his hands to signal the officers and soldiers to surround him: "How dare the remnants of the Xiao family still resist? Today, Liangzhou City is the place where you two are buried! "
Dozens of spears pierced towards him, and Xiao Yan's figure suddenly shot out. The Longquan Sword drew out layers of sword flowers, and the sound of gold and iron clashing was harsh. In an instant, he knocked down three soldiers at the front. The commander in gray clothes threw nine out of his sleeves.The whip is made of steel, its body is tempered with bone-corrosive poison that seals the throat with blood, and the strong wind blows directly into Xiao Yan's heart.
Seeing this, Su Ling tapped the courtyard wall with her toes and flew into the air. The Cold Jade Broken Star Dagger flew out of her hand and accurately grazed the body of the steel whip. The force was such that the commander's arm went numb and the offensive stalled. She landed and quickly turned back to Xiao Yan's side, standing side by side with him on one left and one on the right, with her dagger lying in front of her, her gaze fearless as she faced dozens of officers and soldiers.
The two have a tacit understanding of each other, and now they can use all the inseparable moves they have practiced together for three years. Xiao Yan opened and closed his long sword widely, resisting the attack of a large number of soldiers head-on; Su Ling's body was dexterous and erratic, moving around the flanks, using a short dagger to contain the opponent, specifically targeting the weak points of the opponent's joints and meridians. In just half a stick of incense, more than half of the officers and soldiers fell to the ground in the courtyard. The remaining people did not dare to rush forward rashly, and surrounded the entrance of the courtyard, not daring to rush in.
The gray-clothed commander had a gloomy look on his face, knowing that it would be difficult for his officers and soldiers to capture the two men alone. He blew the signal whistle on his waist, and the sharp whistle penetrated the streets. A moment later, dozens of Dawn League dead soldiers dressed in black and with masks covering their faces came quickly, each holding a sharp blade and using ruthless moves.
Chapter 94: Life and Death
"It's not advisable to stay here for a long time. Let's break out of the city and go to the Zhenlong Ancient Pagoda first!" Xiao Yan whispered to Su Ling, using his wrist strength, the Longquan Sword set off a strong sword energy, forcing the dead man in front of him to retreat. He held Su Ling's wrist with one hand, and the two of them jumped out along the gap in the courtyard wall and rushed into the dark streets.
The pursuers followed closely behind them, with whistles, curses, and footsteps following closely behind them. The entire Liangzhou South Street fell into chaos in an instant. People along the street hurriedly closed their doors and windows, only daring to watch the fighting through the gaps. Xiao Yan protected Su Ling all the way, avoiding ambushes in the streets and walking through narrow alleys. However, the Shumeng soldiers were familiar with the city's terrain and surrounded them in multiple ways, gradually forcing the two to an abandoned mill in the west of the city.
